title: MSTest
description: Microsoft's native testing framework integrated with Visual Studio and .NET CLI.

data.text: `MSTest` is Microsoft's native unit testing framework. It ships with Visual Studio and the .NET SDK, making it the easiest framework to get started with for .NET developers.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install MSTest and the test SDK.
data.code:
dotnet add package MSTest.TestFramework
dotnet add package MSTest.TestAdapter
dotnet add package Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk

data.text: Use `[TestClass]` on the test class and `[TestMethod]` on each test method. MSTest also supports `[DataTestMethod]` for data-driven tests.

data.text: Use `[DataTestMethod]` with `[DataRow]` to run the same test logic against multiple data sets.

data.title: Data-Driven Test

terms.definition: An attribute that identifies a class containing test methods.
An attribute that marks a method as a unit test.
An attribute for parameterized tests that accept multiple data rows.

data.title: Tip
data.text: MSTest is tightly integrated with Visual Studio Test Explorer, making it easy to run and debug tests directly from the IDE.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: MSTest is Microsoft's built-in testing framework
DataTestMethod and DataRow enable data-driven testing
Seamless integration with Visual Studio Test Explorer
data.takeaway: MSTest is the simplest choice for .NET developers already using Visual Studio.
